title: Senior Procurement Specialist
description:
We are looking for a talented Senior Procurement Specialist to join our dynamic team at Upwork. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining marketing solutions that drive business growth and innovation.

**Key Responsibilities:**
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement new features
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code/work
- Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices
- Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and bugs
- Mentor junior team members and share knowledge across the organization
- Communicate effectively with stakeholders to understand business requirements

**Requirements:**
- 7 years of experience in a similar role
- Strong proficiency in Google Ads, Facebook Ads, Team Management, HubSpot
- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience
- Strong communication and collaboration skills

**What We Offer:**
- Competitive salary of AFN 3,800,000 – AFN 6,500,000 per year
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
- 100% remote — work from anywhere
- Generous PTO and paid holidays
- Learning and development budget
- Collaborative and inclusive work environment

Hobby Lobby is seeking a Associate Full Stack Developer who is passionate about building innovative solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to make a real impact in a fast-growing organization.

- Annual salary: AFN 2,200,000 – AFN 3,800,000

- Stock options / performance bonus

description:
Join Shopify as a Staff Sales Manager and be part of our mission to transform the industry. We're a team of driven professionals who love what we do and are committed to excellence.

- Professional development opportunities
- Team offsites and company events
- Modern office with great amenities

We are looking for a talented Principal Compliance Officer to join our dynamic team at Zapier. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining general solutions that drive business growth and innovation.

**Key Responsibilities:**
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement new features
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code/work
- Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices
- Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and bugs
- Mentor junior team members and share knowledge across the organization
- Communicate effectively with stakeholders to understand business requirements

**Requirements:**
- 9 years of experience in a similar role
- Strong proficiency in Stakeholder Management, Project Management, Microsoft Office, Team Management
- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience
- Strong communication and collaboration skills

**What We Offer:**
- Competitive salary of AFN 2,200,000 – AFN 3,800,000 per year
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
- 100% remote — work from anywhere
- Generous PTO and paid holidays
- Learning and development budget
- Collaborative and inclusive work environment

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Join Amazon as a Senior DevOps Engineer and be part of our mission to transform the industry. We're a team of driven professionals who love what we do and are committed to excellence.

**The Opportunity:**
We're expanding our team and looking for a skilled Senior DevOps Engineer with strong expertise in tech. This role offers tremendous growth potential and the chance to work on challenging, meaningful projects.

**Day-to-Day Responsibilities:**
- Plan, prioritize, and execute tech projects to meet deadlines
- Collaborate with team members across departments
- Create detailed documentation and reports
- Conduct research and analysis to support decision-making
- Present findings and recommendations to leadership
- Continuously improve processes and workflows

**Must-Have Qualifications:**
- Minimum 4 years of experience as a Senior DevOps Engineer or similar
- In-depth knowledge of Git, GraphQL, Leadership, TypeScript
- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
- Team player with a proactive mindset

**Perks & Benefits:**
- Salary range: AFN 1,200,000 – AFN 2,200,000
- 100% remote — work from anywhere
- Health and wellness allowance
- Professional development opportunities
- Team offsites and company events
- Modern office with great amenities

We are looking for a talented Junior Database Administrator to join our dynamic team at JetBlue Airline. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining tech solutions that drive business growth and innovation.

**Key Responsibilities:**
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement new features
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code/work
- Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices
- Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and bugs
- Mentor junior team members and share knowledge across the organization
- Communicate effectively with stakeholders to understand business requirements

**Requirements:**
- 6 years of experience in a similar role
- Strong proficiency in AWS, Team Management, Project Management, REST APIs
- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience
- Strong communication and collaboration skills

**What We Offer:**
- Competitive salary of AFN 6,500,000 – AFN 11,000,000 per year
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
- 100% remote — work from anywhere
- Generous PTO and paid holidays
- Learning and development budget
- Collaborative and inclusive work environment

Twitter is seeking a Principal Android Developer who is passionate about building innovative solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to make a real impact in a fast-growing organization.

**About the Role:**
As a Principal Android Developer, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our tech capabilities. You will work closely with our product, engineering, and business teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

**What You'll Do:**
- Lead and execute tech initiatives from conception to delivery
- Work with stakeholders across the business to identify opportunities
- Develop and implement strategies that align with company goals
- Analyze data and metrics to measure impact and drive improvements
- Stay up-to-date with industry trends and best practices

- Expertise in Python, Kubernetes, GraphQL, Team Management
- Proven track record of delivering results in a fast-paced environment
- Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills

- Annual salary: AFN 600,000 – AFN 1,200,000
- 100% remote — work from anywhere
- Stock options / performance bonus
- Premium health insurance
- 401k/pension with company match
- Flexible working hours
